explanation: Settlers from Phocaea, a Greek city on the coast of modern Turkey, founded it. Rome only took control in 49 BC, after the city backed Pompey against Julius Caesar.

claims.text: Marseille was founded around 600 BC as Massalia by Greek colonists from Phocaea.
Marseille was not founded by Romans, Phoenicians or Celts.
Phocaea was a Greek city on the Aegean coast of Anatolia, in modern Turkey.
Massalia sided with Pompey and was besieged and taken by Julius Caesar's forces in 49 BC.
